school_level.academic_text: Taught postgraduate (University portal): a candidate shall hold a Bachelor's degree of this University or a qualification of equivalent standard from this University or another comparable institution accepted for this purpose, and shall satisfy any other admission requirements prescribed for the relevant curriculum. An application for exemption shall be considered on a case by case basis. HKU Business School taught masters (school page, 2027 intake): 'Hold a recognised bachelor’s or equivalent.' FAQ: 'Hold a recognised degree or equivalent.' No numeric GPA, honours class, percentage, or letter-grade minimum is published for these taught masters. The Graduate School page at gradsch.hku.hk discusses MPhil/PhD (including a Faculty of Business and Economics GMAT/GRE requirement and higher English scores) and is not used here as the taught-master minimum.
school_level.english_text: HKU Business School masters page: 'Obtain a TOEFL/IELTS score if you are not from an English-medium university. Minimum score requirement: TOEFL (Internet-based): A score of 80 or above for tests taken before 21 January 2026; or A score of 4.5 or above for tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards. IELTS: 6 (with no subtest below 5.5).' University taught-postgraduate page: an applicant seeking admission on a qualification from a university or comparable institution outside Hong Kong of which the language of teaching and/or examination is not English must obtain TOEFL 80 or above (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 or above (from 21 January 2026), or IELTS overall band 6 with no subtest lower than 5.5, or GCE Grade C or above, or IGCSE Grade C or above, or Cambridge Test of Proficiency in English Language Grade C or above. 'Starting from the 2026 intake, IELTS and TOEFL tests must be taken within two years prior to September 1 of each admissions year.' School page also: tests must be taken within two years prior to September 1 of each admissions year; score reports are valid for two years only; TOEFL iBT Home Edition and IELTS One Skill Retake will not be accepted.
school_level.gmat_gre_text: HKU Business School taught masters: 'GMAT/GRE scores are not required, but a good GMAT/GRE score will be favourably considered and can be helpful for marginal cases.' 'GMAT score reports are valid for five years.' No numeric GMAT or GRE minimum is published for these 12 masters. MBA, part-time MBA, IMBA and EMBA have separate rules on their own pages. The Graduate School sentence that Faculty of Business and Economics applicants must obtain satisfactory GMAT or GRE appears on a page that refers to MPhil/PhD applications and is not applied here to taught masters.
school_level.waiver_text: School admissions page: 'Obtain a TOEFL/IELTS score if you are not from an English-medium university.' FAQ: 'An applicant who wishes to be admitted on the basis of a qualification from a university or comparable institution outside Hong Kong where the language of teaching or examination is not English is required to obtain a TOEFL/IELTS score.' University taught-postgraduate page uses the same outside-Hong-Kong and non-English teaching and/or examination condition. Programme portal pages for the 12 masters shorten this to 'if you are not from an English teaching university.'
documents: Online application via the Taught Postgraduate Online Application System; non-refundable application fee HK$780 for each application (2027 masters admissions page).

Two referee statements; at least one must be an academic referee from the university the applicant has graduated or will graduate from, and that referee must provide an official university profile or directory link. A form without that link is incomplete and will not be processed.
CV.

Academic certificate file: graduate transcript or latest official transcript; graduation certificate or, for Mainland China institutions, the Online Verification Report of Higher Education Qualification Certificate; bachelor’s degree certificate or the Online Verification Report of Higher Education Degree Certificate; official ranking certificate. Non-English documents need a formally certified English translation. Mainland verification reports: Chinese and English versions, validity 6 months or the longest available.

Working experience proof if applicable: valid employment proof of internship of all positions, or most recent full-time employment, whichever is applicable. Contracts or correspondence with colleagues are not accepted.
Language report if not from an English-medium university. TOEFL code of HKU: 9671; School Type: 01-Graduate; Department: 82-Business and Commerce.
Photo identification (passport photo page, ID card, or Exit-Entry Permit).
Others: personal statement; GMAT/GRE score report if submitted; professional qualifications such as ACCA, CFA, CPA.

academic.text: A recognised Bachelor's degree or equivalent. No GPA or honours minimum is stated.

other: On the portal, TOEFL and IELTS are not listed as a universal English minimum. They are one possible way for applicants with more than seven years of work experience to be exempted from GRK/GMAT/GRE: TOEFL 80 before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 on or after that date (code 9671), or IELTS Academic overall 6 with no subtest lower than 5.5, or an English-medium degree, or a satisfactory IMBA English Admission Test, or a satisfactory EA score.
An IMBA FAQ search snippet, not opened in full, instead says a recognised English-medium degree OR satisfactory GRK/GMAT/EA/GRE/TOEFL/IELTS. That formulation differs from the portal.
english.waiver: Portal exemption route only: applicants with more than seven years of work experience who obtained a degree from a university of which the medium of instruction was English might be exempted from the GRK/GMAT/GRE requirement.
english.validity: The portal states GMAT and GRE results within 5 years. It does not state a separate TOEFL/IELTS validity period on the entrance list. A brochure search snippet says TOEFL and IELTS are valid for two years and are not Home Edition.

gmat_gre.text: Satisfactory GRK / GMAT / GMAT Executive Assessment / GRE scores. GRK: meeting the minimum scores of the year, which vary each year and are not printed as a number. GMAT ≥ 580; GMAT Focus Edition ≥ 545; result within 5 years. GRE: Verbal ≥ 150, Quantitative ≥ 150, total equivalent to GMAT ≥ 580; result within 5 years. Applicants with more than seven years of work experience might be exempted from GRK/GMAT/GRE by one of: a satisfactory IMBA English Admission Test; a satisfactory EA score; the TOEFL or IELTS scores above; or an English-medium degree.
